note.text: Owner decision: pause provider-backed marketplace/plugin workflow evals while constructing the standalone Tiber harness. Continue deterministic protocol/behavior fixtures, strict Rust gates, release checks, multi-agent final review, exact-revision CI, and opt-in live authority smoke evidence. Revisit the eval strategy after Tiber runs the full workflow end to end; redesign it around qualitative judgment, orchestration quality, context selection, tool choice, abstention, and recovery rather than duplicating workflow mechanics.
